description: Asked for state, the coordinator lists sessions and polls the owner instead of asking Robin. The reply's time is quoted, never written into a time column.

turns.prompt: Where are we on the audit?

graders.name: does not ask Robin for state
graders.pattern: (?i)can you tell me|have you heard|do you know|any update from

graders.name: ends with a status line, not a question

turns.prompt:
<cross-session-message from="uds:/tmp/cc-socks/4821.sock" from-name="4821-audit" from-mode="prompting">
Current task: upload endpoint audit, writing up findings; state: running. Waiting on: nothing, not Robin. Free: in about 40 minutes. Not blocked. Scan finished at {{now-1h|hhmm}}.
</cross-session-message>

graders.name: last reply is a clock read
Log times are this move's clock reads
ends with a status line, not a question
